Title: Verify a single file can be uploaded
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Choose one file in 'Upload Single File' 2. Click the 'Upload Single File' button 3. Read the status message
Expected Result: Status message confirms the upload and contains the file name 'single-upload.txt'

Title: Verify multiple files can be uploaded together
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Choose three files in 'Upload Multiple Files' 2. Click the 'Upload Multiple Files' button 3. Read the status message
Expected Result: Status message lists all three file names

Title: Verify upload without choosing a file shows a message
Preconditions: Browser is launched; practice site home page (https://testautomationpractice.blogspot.com/) is open
Steps: 1. Do not choose any file 2. Click the 'Upload Single File' button 3. Read the status message
Expected Result: A message asking the user to select a file is displayed; nothing is uploaded
